result.summary: Micro-offer: setup + invoice kit to help Spanish-speaking freelancers accept verified payments via CobrAMO; hybrid digital product + manual verification for fast closings.
result.opportunity: Many microbusinesses/freelancers lack a simple, trustable flow to request payment and verify bank transfers; they buy ready templates and short setup services to close clients faster.
result.target_customer: Spanish-speaking freelancers and microempresarios (Spain, LATAM) who invoice clients by bank transfer or manual methods and need a fast, verified payment flow.
result.offer: 'Cobro Listo AMO' — €39 one-time: (1) personalized payment instruction PDF (uses CobrAMO URL), (2) editable invoice/receipt template (PDF/Google Sheets), (3) short verification checklist + message script for clients, (4) optional manual verification support (one confirmation cycle).
result.why_now: Digital template marketplaces and creator platforms actively sell invoicing/payment tools (e.g., LemonSqueezy shows digital-product demand). Small sellers still prefer simple transfer-based flows and verification help to close sales quickly.
actions_completed: Viewed CobrAMO public page to confirm payment infrastructure and public instructions
Fetched LemonSqueezy 'digital products' page as independent evidence of template demand
Read repository data/attempts.jsonl to learn past IAMO strategies and avoid rule violations
Attempted to fetch Etsy search (403) — noted limitation

execution_packet.channel: Direct message posting in Spanish freelancer groups (LinkedIn + Facebook) and listing on Gumroad (digital product); outreach templates for one-to-one replies
execution_packet.subject: Cobro Listo AMO — Configuro tu flujo de cobro y te doy la plantilla (39€)
execution_packet.message: Hola — ofrezco un paquete rápido para emitir facturas y recibir transferencias verificadas: instrucciones personalizadas para que tu cliente pague con los métodos públicos de AMO (https://cobramo.netlify.app/), plantilla de factura editable, y verificación de comprobante hasta confirmación final. Precio: €39. Referencia comercial: RANK-IAMO4. ¿Te interesa que te envíe el PDF con pasos y datos para pagar?
execution_packet.deliverable: ZIP with: personalized payment-instructions PDF (with CobrAMO link), editable invoice template (Google Sheets + PDF sample), short verification checklist and client message scripts, and delivery receipt template.

result.differentiation_from_previous: Avoids using CobrAMO contacts as prospects (fixing IAMO1 error). Unlike IAMO2's pure passive template, this is a hybrid quick-setup + verification service tailored to Spanish speakers and explicitly guides clients to CobrAMO for payment, increasing conversion probability while remaining compliant.
result.next_step: Executor: build deliverable files (invoice template, personalized instruction PDF), create Gumroad listing and short landing post, publish in 3 Spanish freelancer groups with the prepared message; accept payment via CobrAMO and require payer to include 'RANK-IAMO4' in the payment note or conversation.
result.notes: Assumptions: clients will accept paying via methods listed on CobrAMO and can add payment reference in notes or conversation. Risks: platform posting may require moderation; some buyers prefer established marketplaces. Legal/tax compliance must be handled by seller; this package is delivery of templates and simple verification assistance only.
